verdicts.reason: Both have the same serious faults. The magnifier icon has been pulled out of its search-bar box, blown up and left pixelated, so it is now the main focal point. That leaves the PPC Campaigns box with an empty right cell and pushes the headline into second place. The hero photo has also shrunk to a small inset floating on white, with uneven gaps around it. The only difference is that the photo sits a few pixels higher in B, which shows a little more of the arms but leaves a larger empty gap at the bottom. That is not enough to call either one better.
